messages:
Jordan: Quick sync — Origen (customer) needs a VPC/on-prem readiness review before private deploy. Can we schedule a 30m call this week? Proposed slots: Tue 10-10:30 PT, Wed 16-16:30 PT, Thu 9-9:30 PT. Agenda in next message.

Priya: I can do Tue and Thu. Please include network & KMS checklist.

Sam: Wed works for me too. We should reserve ~10m for model artifact checksum + quantization caveats.

Lina: I'll invite Origen's infra lead (maya@origen). Can we add SSO and audit logs to agenda?

Jordan: Agenda (draft):
- 5m intros & scope
- 10m network/VPC peering, firewall rules
- 5m KMS/HSM & secrets flow
- 5m model artifact transfer, checksums
- 5m rollback & mitigation + next steps
If anyone wants more time on any item say now.

Sam: Can we add 'DB migration access window' — customer asked about it. +1 to checksums.

Priya: Good call. Add 5m for 'data migration / DB access' slot, we can compress other items.

Jordan: Updated agenda uploaded: https://redwood-internal/notes/origen-vpc-readiness (draft) — please leave comments.

qa-bot: run: capacity-check --region us-west2 --min-gpu=2
Result: OK (expected throughput 180 rps) :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Reminder: run network-test from customer's VPN prior to call. Command:
```
curl -v --resolve origen.internal:443:10.10.0.5 https://origen.internal/health
```

Lina: Maya from Origen confirmed Tue 10 PT but only for 30m. She asked to have the network checklist in advance.

Jordan: Ok locking Tue 10-10:30 PT. Action items before call:
- Priya: publish network checklist + firewall rules template
- Sam: prepare artifact checksum steps + tool versions
- Lina: share invite + Maya contact
- Ops: run capacity-check and post results
I'll post final invite + Zoom link.

Priya: I'll drop the checklist in the doc and ping here when done :soon:

Sam: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a short demo of transfer + sha256 commands.

Lina: Invite sent to everyone (zoom link + calendar). Maya included. Quick question: any specific docs needed for SSO (Okta) config to share ahead?

Jordan: Noted — Priya can include SSO snippet. If nothing else, see you all Tue 10 PT. :rocket:
